<title>Waiting for a meeting to start</title>
<transcript>
[0] Hetty Marsh: Hello, can you hear me?
[1] Hetty Marsh: I think my microphone was off.
[2] Colm Ashby: I can hear you now.
[3] Colm Ashby: How are you doing today?
[4] Hetty Marsh: Oh, not too bad, thanks.
[5] Hetty Marsh: A bit tired.
[6] Hetty Marsh: How about you?
[7] Colm Ashby: Fine, fine.
[8] Colm Ashby: It has been one of those weeks, you know how it is.
[9] Hetty Marsh: I do.
[10] Hetty Marsh: Is it raining where you are?
[11] Hetty Marsh: It is really coming down here.
[12] Colm Ashby: Just grey.
[13] Colm Ashby: It keeps threatening to but never quite does.
[14] Hetty Marsh: Typical.
[15] Hetty Marsh: Well, shall we wait for the others to join before we start?
[16] Colm Ashby: Let's give them a couple of minutes.
[17] Colm Ashby: No point saying everything twice.
[18] Hetty Marsh: Agreed.
[19] Hetty Marsh: I will go and get a cup of tea while we wait, if that is all right.
[20] Colm Ashby: Go ahead.
[21] Colm Ashby: I might do the same.
[22] Colm Ashby: Back in a moment.
[23] Hetty Marsh: Lovely.
[24] Hetty Marsh: See you in a minute, then.
[25] Colm Ashby: See you in a minute.
</transcript>
